script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. LOS ANGELES - DAY

A busy STREET. People hurrying by. CAR ALARMS wail. A LADDER leans against the side of a building.

JASMINE, 26, a young artist, climbs down the ladder, a can of PAINT in one hand and a paintbrush in the other. She glances around, spotting her friend SAM, 28, who's set up a small easel nearby, sketching the scene.

JASMINE
(smiling)
You're really something, Sam. Setting up shop right here on the sidewalk.

SAM
(looking up, smiling)
A girl's got to make ends meet, right? Besides, I love painting en plein air.

They share a laugh. Jasmine sets up her easel and paints the scene, while Sam continues to sketch.

SCENE 2 - INT. CAFE - DAY

A cozy CAFETERIA. Jasmine and Sam sit across from each other, sipping coffee.

JASMINE
You know, Sam, we've been friends for a long time.

SAM
(looking thoughtful)
Yes, we have. Since we were kids.

Jasmine leans in, her eyes serious.

JASMINE
I need to tell you something. Something I've been keeping from you.

Sam looks worried.

SAM
What is it, Jas? You can tell me anything.

Jasmine hesitates, then takes a deep breath.

JASMINE
I... I've been offered a job in New York. A really good one.

Sam's eyes widen in surprise.

SAM
New York? That's a huge opportunity!

Jasmine nods, but looks sad.

JASMINE
Yes, it is. But it means leaving everything and everyone I know here behind. Including you.

Sam reaches across the table and takes Jasmine's hand.

SAM
I'll support you, Jas. No matter where life takes you.

Jasmine smiles, tears in her eyes.

JASMINE
Thank you, Sam. That means more to me than you'll ever know.

SCENE 3 - INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jasmine's small APARTMENT. She's packing up her belongings, looking sad and hesitant. The phone rings. She answers.

JASMINE
(on the phone)
Hi, Sam.

SAM (V.O.)
Hey, Jas. I was just thinking about you. How's the packing going?

Jasmine sighs.

JASMINE
Slowly. Every box I pack feels like a piece of me is leaving.

SAM (V.O.)
I know how that feels. But remember, this is an opportunity. A chance to start fresh.

Jasmine smiles, even as tears stream down her face.

JASMINE
You're right. And I won't forget the lessons I've learned here. Like the importance of friendship.

SCENE 4 - EXT. NEW YORK CITY - DAY

A bustling STREET in NEW YORK CITY. Jasmine stands in front of a building, looking up at the address on the door.

JASMINE
(to herself)
Here goes nothing.

She takes a deep breath and enters the building.

SCENE 5 - INT. OFFICE - DAY

A modern OFFICE. Jasmine sits at her new desk, looking around in awe. A knock at the door. She looks up. It's her boss, MRS. THOMPSON.

MRS. THOMPSON
(smiling)
You look settled in, Jasmine. I'm glad you decided to take this opportunity.

Jasmine smiles, feeling a sense of accomplishment.

JASMINE
Thank you, Mrs. Thompson. I won't let you down.

SCENE 6 - INT. PARK - DAY

A beautiful PARK. Jasmine sits on a bench, sketching in her notebook. She looks up as she hears footsteps approaching. It's Sam.

SAM
(surprised)
Jas! I didn't expect to see you here.

Jasmine looks happy to see her friend.

JASMINE
I came to visit. To see the city that's become your home.

They sit together on the bench and chat, catching up on each other's lives.

SCENE 7 - INT. RESTAURANT - NIGHT

A dimly lit RESTAURANT. Jasmine and Sam sit across from each other, glasses of wine in front of them.

JASMINE
Sam, I've missed you so much.

SAM
And I've missed you, Jas. This city just isn't the same without you here.

They share a long, meaningful look.

SAM
You know, Jas, I've been thinking. About us. About our friendship.

Jasmine looks curious.

JASMINE
What about it?

SAM
I think... I think I'm in love with you.

Jasmine is taken aback, but a small smile plays at the corners of her mouth.

JASMINE
(laughing softly)
I've known that for a long time, Sam.

They share a tender kiss.

SCENE 8 - INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jasmine's NEW APARTMENT. She sits on the couch, staring at a picture of her and Sam. She smiles, remembering their conversation in the restaurant.

JASMINE (V.O.)
New York is beautiful, but it's the people in it that make it home.

SCENE 9 - INT. OFFICE - DAY

Jasmine's boss, Mrs. Thompson, calls her into her office.

MRS. THOMPSON
Jasmine, I have some good news. Your work has been noticed. You've been promoted.

Jasmine is elated.

JASMINE
Thank you, Mrs. Thompson. I'll work even harder.

SCENE 10 - EXT. NEW YORK CITY - DAY

Jasmine stands on the balcony of her apartment, looking out at the city. She feels a sense of peace and contentment.

JASMINE (V.O.)
I've found my place in this world. And I have you, Sam, to thank for that.

SCENE 11 - INT. CAFETERIA - DAY

Jasmine and Sam sit in the same cafe where they used to meet, holding hands.

JASMINE
I couldn't have done it without you, Sam.

SAM
And I couldn't have asked for a better friend.

They share a smile.

SCENE 12 - INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jasmine's apartment. She's packing up her things to leave for the day. She hears a knock at the door. It's Sam.

SAM
Jas, I have a surprise for you.

Jasmine opens the door, and Sam hands her a small box.

JASMINE
(opening the box)
Oh, Sam. It's beautiful.

It's a sketch of Jasmine, done by Sam.

JASMINE
You're too kind. I'll treasure this always.

They share a tender moment.

SCENE 13 - EXT. NEW YORK CITY - DAY

Jasmine stands in the park, looking at the skyline. She turns to see Sam approaching. They sit on the bench and watch the sunset together.

JASMINE
I'm glad I came here, Sam. I've found a new home, and I have you to thank for that.

SAM
And I've found a new appreciation for the beauty of this city. And for the beauty of our friendship.

They share a warm embrace.

SCENE 14 - INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jasmine's apartment. She's packing up her things to leave for good. She looks around one last time, remembering the happy moments she's had there.

JASMINE (V.O.)
It's time to move on. But I'll never forget the lessons I've learned here. And the love and support of my dear friend, Sam.

SCENE 15 - EXT. NEW YORK CITY - DAY

Jasmine stands on the sidewalk, surrounded by her suitcases. Sam appears, offering her a hand.

SAM
Wherever life takes you, Jas, I'll be there.

Jasmine takes Sam's hand and they walk off into the sunset, their friendship stronger than ever.

FADE OUT.
